title: Google Cloud Logging Reporter
description: Reports API gateway metrics, logs and health checks to Google Cloud Logging

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Activate the Google Cloud Logging reporter

projectId.title: GCP Project ID
projectId.description: Google Cloud project ID. Omit to use the value from the GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT environment variable or metadata server.

logName.title: Log name
logName.description: Cloud Logging log name under which entries are written

type.title: Resource type
type.description: Monitored resource type, e.g. global, gce_instance, k8s_container

labels.title: Resource labels
labels.description: Key/value labels attached to the MonitoredResource

credentialsFile.title: Service Account credentials file
credentialsFile.description: Absolute path to a service-account JSON key file. Omit to use Application Default Credentials (ADC).

captureErrors.title: Capture HTTP errors
captureErrors.description: Set log severity to ERROR for HTTP 5xx responses, WARNING for 4xx

reportHealthChecks.title: Report health checks
reportHealthChecks.description: Write a log entry on each endpoint health-check state transition

reportLogs.title: Report full request/response logs
reportLogs.description: Write a log entry containing full request and response headers and bodies (high volume — disabled by default)

reportMessageMetrics.title: Report message metrics
reportMessageMetrics.description: Write a log entry for async message metrics from event-driven APIs

reportMonitor.title: Report node monitor
reportMonitor.description: Write a log entry for gateway node monitor events

tracePrefix.title: Trace prefix
tracePrefix.description: Optional prefix for the trace field, e.g. projects/my-project/traces/
